title: achillea wilsoniana
intro: Achillea wilsoniana, commonly known as Yarrow Wilson's or Western Yarrow, is a perennial plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Achillea wilsoniana include its antiseptic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
